name: OrchestratorAgent
description: The workflow driver — constructed directly in main.py, not registered in AgentRegistry. Makes one LLM pre-flight call (a 'ping' health check) before any step, then loads the project manifest, runs each workflow step with fallback-tier dispatch (workflows/agent_registry.yaml), merges outputs into persistent project state, and builds the final report. Phase 0: validates each step's artifacts against the Pydantic contracts at the step boundary (contracts.enforce warn|block) and carries the resolved safety policy, environment and contracts config in the request. Phase 1: carries the resolved requirements block in the request, validates requirements / traceability at step boundaries, and logs how to build requirements.json when cached discovery skips comprehension.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: The request payload (project_name, workflow, module_filter, etc.)

outputs.name: contract_checks
outputs.description: Per step result: {checked, failed, mode, violations}
